            "software": "coding",
            "long_research": "research",
            "multimodal": "design",
        }.get(metadata.get("task_kind"), "research")
        if role not in PRESET_ROLES:
            raise DomainError("Unknown independent Worker role")
        selected = [{"objective": quest["goal"], "role": role}]
    return [
        {**item, "key": "task" if len(selected) == 1 else f"task_{index + 1}"}
        for index, item in enumerate(selected)
    ]


class SuperagentDelegation:
    def __init__(self, store, graph, teams, *, max_concurrency=2):
        if type(max_concurrency) is not int or max_concurrency < 1:
            raise ValueError("Worker concurrency must be a positive integer")
        self.store, self.graph, self.teams = store, graph, teams
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency

    def prepare(self, quest_id):
        """Resume contract preparation at its last committed boundary; no model calls."""
        from .governance import GovernanceService

        with self.store.connection() as c:
            quest = dict(c.execute("SELECT * FROM quests WHERE id=?", (quest_id,)).fetchone())
            mandate = c.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM delegation_mandates WHERE quest_id=?", (quest_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if mandate is None or mandate["state"] != "active":
                return False
            _, policy = _active(c, mandate["id"], quest_id)
        authority = DelegationAuthority(mandate["id"])
        if quest["status"] in {"cancelled", "rejected", "failed", "completed"}:
            return False
        assignments = _assignments(quest)
        from .superagent_swarm import (
            assignment_tools,
            edges_for,
            graph_matches_assignments,
            team_assignments,
        )

        execution_team = team_assignments(quest)
        count = len(assignments)
        if count > policy["max_workers"]:
            raise DomainError("Independent dispatches exceed the Worker mandate")
        token_budgets = _split_budget(policy["max_tokens"], count)
        tool_budgets = _split_budget(policy.get("initial_tool_budget", policy["max_tools"]), count)
        time_budgets = _split_budget(policy["max_seconds"], count)
        nodes = [
            {
                "key": item["key"],
                "objective": item["objective"],
                "success_criteria": ["delivery_review"],
                "budget_tokens": token_budgets[index],
                "required_capabilities": {},
                "allowed_tools": assignment_tools(policy, item),
                **(
                    {
                        "required_predecessor_deliveries": item["depends_on"],
                    }
                    if item.get("depends_on")
                    else {}
                ),
                **(
                    {
                        "capacity_bounds": {
                            "max_source_receipt_bytes": 32768,
                            "max_artifact_bytes": 16384,
                            "max_delivery_bytes": 16384,
                        }
                    }
                    if execution_team is not None
                    else {}
                ),
            }
            for index, item in enumerate(assignments)
        ]
        try:
            plan = self.graph.get(quest_id)
        except KeyError:
            plan = None
        if plan is None:
            # Independent tasks stay coarse; detailed plans belong inside Workers.
            plan = self.graph.propose(
                quest_id,
                {
                    "nodes": nodes,
                    "edges": edges_for(assignments),
                    "max_total_tokens": policy["max_tokens"],
                    "max_duration_seconds": policy["max_seconds"],
                },
                expected_version=quest["version"],
            )
            with self.store.unit_of_work() as work:
                current = work.get_quest(quest_id)
                metadata = json.loads(current["metadata"])
                if count == 1:
                    metadata["worker_role"] = assignments[0]["role"]
                work.connection.execute(
                    "UPDATE quests SET metadata=? WHERE id=?", (_json(metadata), quest_id)
                )
        if not graph_matches_assignments(plan, assignments):
            raise DomainError("Task contracts changed after independent dispatch")
        quest = self.store.get_quest(quest_id)
        if plan["status"] == "proposed":
            self.graph.approve(
                quest_id,
                plan["digest"],
                plan["plan_revision"],
                expected_version=quest["version"],
                actor=authority.actor,
                _delegation=authority,
            )
        quest = self.store.get_quest(quest_id)
        if quest["status"] not in {"approved", "queued", "running"}:
            return False
        with self.store.connection() as c:
            team = c.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM team_proposals WHERE quest_id=? AND plan_revision=? "
                "AND status IN ('proposed','approved') ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1",
                (quest_id, quest["plan_revision"]),
            ).fetchone()
        if team is None:
            profiles = self.store.list_models()
            known = [
                p
                for p in profiles
                if p.enabled
                and not p.quarantine_reason
                and p.context_window
                and p.max_output_tokens
                and p.tool_calling_support
                and p.tool_calling_support.supported
                and p.structured_output_support
                and p.structured_output_support.supported
            ]
            if not known:
                raise DomainError("No enabled Worker model with known limits")
            window = min(p.context_window for p in known)
            output = min(8192, min(p.max_output_tokens for p in known), window // 4)
            roles = []
            for index, assignment in enumerate(assignments):
                base_role = assignment["role"]
                requirements = {
                    capability: 0.0
                    for capability in PRESET_ROLES[base_role]
                    if any(capability in p.capability_measurements for p in known)
                }
                member_output = min(output, token_budgets[index] // 4)
                roles.append(
                    RoleSpec(
                        id=base_role if count == 1 else f"{base_role}_{index + 1}",
                        task_node_key=assignment["key"],
                        dynamic=count > 1,
                        required_capabilities=requirements,
                        tools=assignment_tools(policy, assignment),
                        input_tokens=min(window, 65536, token_budgets[index] - member_output),
                        output_tokens=member_output,
                        max_steps=policy["max_steps"],
                        max_tool_calls=tool_budgets[index],
                        max_duration_seconds=time_budgets[index],
                        responsibility="Execute only your assigned expert objective. "
                        "Plan your own steps, read declared predecessor deliveries before using "
                        "their findings, and report through the Router. Write only inside "
                        + policy["write_scope"]
                        + ".",
                        input_contract=[
                            (
                                "Use the complete original request for constraints; execute your "
                                "current node objective. Other assignments belong to their Workers."
                            ),
                            *(
                                [
                                    "Read the full completed predecessor deliveries with "
                                    "worker_read_completed_delivery before relying on them: "
                                    + ", ".join(assignment["depends_on"])
                                ]
                                if assignment.get("depends_on")
                                else []
                            ),
                        ],
                        REDACTED,
                        acceptance_criteria=["delivery_review"],
                    )
                )
            proposed = self.teams.propose(
                quest_id,
                roles,
                CompositionLimits(
                    max_members=count,
                    max_depth=policy.get("max_help_depth", 0),
                    max_concurrency=(
                        1
                        if execution_team and execution_team["strategy"] == "sequential"
                        else min(count, self.max_concurrency)
                    ),
                    max_total_tokens=policy["max_tokens"],
                    max_total_tool_calls=policy["max_tools"],
                    allowed_tools=sorted({tool for role in roles for tool in role.tools}),
                ),
                strategy="complementarity",
                expected_version=quest["version"],
            )
            team_digest = proposed["proposal_digest"]
        else:
            team_digest = team["proposal_digest"]
        quest = self.store.get_quest(quest_id)
        with self.store.connection() as c:
            row = c.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM team_proposals WHERE quest_id=? AND proposal_digest=?",
                (quest_id, team_digest),
            ).fetchone()
        if row["status"] == "proposed":
            self.teams.approve(
                quest_id,
                quest["plan_revision"],
                team_digest,
                expected_version=quest["version"],
                actor=authority.actor,
                _delegation=authority,
            )
        # Writes are confined to task-private artifacts. Existing ToolEngine scope,
        # grants, revision chains and immutable receipts still authorize each effect.
        governance = GovernanceService(self.store)
        scope = governance._workspace_scope(policy["write_scope"])
        with self.store.connection() as c:
            granted = c.execute(
                "SELECT revoked_at FROM task_grants WHERE quest_id=? AND plan_revision=? "
                "AND resource_scope=?",
                (quest_id, quest["plan_revision"], scope),
            ).fetchone()
        if granted and granted["revoked_at"] is not None:
            raise DomainError("Task output authorization was revoked")
        root = Path(self.store.workspace.root).resolve()
        path = root
        for part in Path(policy["write_scope"]).parts:
            path = path / part
            path.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            info = path.lstat()
            if (
                not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)
                or stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode)
                or (
                    getattr(info, "st_file_attributes", 0)
                    & getattr(stat, "FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT", 0x400)
                )
                or path.resolve() != path
            ):
                raise DomainError("Task output directory must not be linked")
        with self.store.unit_of_work() as work:
            _active(work.connection, mandate["id"], quest_id)
            current = work.get_quest(quest_id)
            if current["plan_revision"] != quest["plan_revision"]:
                raise DomainError("Task changed during output preparation")
            old = work.connection.execute(
                "SELECT revoked_at FROM task_grants WHERE quest_id=? "
                "AND workspace_id=? AND resource_scope=?",
                (quest_id, self.store.workspace.id, scope),
            ).fetchone()
            if old and old["revoked_at"] is not None:
                raise DomainError("Task output authorization was revoked")
            if old is None:
                work.connection.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO task_grants VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,NULL)",
                    (
                        quest_id,
                        self.store.workspace.id,
                        current["plan_revision"],
                        scope,
                        authority.actor,
                        now_iso(),
                    ),
                )
                work.append_event(
                    ForgeEvent(
                        event_type="governance.workspace_granted",
                        quest_id=quest_id,
                        payload={"scope": scope, "actor": authority.actor, "policy": POLICY},
                    )
                )
            work.connection.execute(
                "UPDATE delegation_mandates SET setup_complete=1 WHERE id=? AND state='active'",
                (mandate["id"],),
            )
        return True

    def tick(self):
        with self.store.connection() as c:
            rows = c.execute(
                "SELECT q.id FROM quests q JOIN delegation_mandates m ON m.quest_id=q.id "
                "WHERE m.state='active' AND q.status IN ('proposed','awaiting_approval','approved') "
                "AND m.setup_complete=0 "
                "ORDER BY q.created_at LIMIT 16"
            ).fetchall()
        prepared = 0
        for row in rows:
            try:
                prepared += bool(self.prepare(row["id"]))
            except (DomainError, ValueError, KeyError):
                # Retain the last committed phase; supervision retries without
                # fabricating approval, models or evidence.
                continue
        from .superagent_swarm import recover_expert_requests

        return prepared + recover_expert_requests(self)

def _expansion_source(connection, quest_id, event_id):
    """Read the exact paid model request; event payloads alone are insufficient."""
    from .superagent_delegation import _active
    from .worker_recovery import unresolved_calls

    event = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM events WHERE id=? AND quest_id=? AND event_type='worker.help_requested'", (event_id, quest_id)).fetchone()
    payload = json.loads(event["payload"]) if event else {}
    run = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=? AND quest_id=?", (payload.get("run_id"), quest_id)).fetchone()
    mandate = connection.execute("SELECT id FROM delegation_mandates WHERE quest_id=?", (quest_id,)).fetchone()
    if not event or not run or not mandate or event["worker_id"] != run["worker_id"] or payload.get("plan_id") != run["plan_id"] or payload.get("task_node_key") != run["node_key"]:
        raise DomainError("Expert expansion source is unavailable")
    _, policy = _active(connection, mandate["id"], quest_id)
    args = {"experts": payload.get("experts"), "reason": payload.get("reason")}
    if not valid_expert_tool_call({"name": "worker_request_experts", "arguments": args}, policy["version"]):
        raise DomainError("Expert expansion has an invalid model contract")
    matched = any(
        call.get("id") == payload.get("model_call_id")
        and call.get("function", {}).get("name") == "worker_request_experts"
        and json.loads(call["function"].get("arguments", "{}")) == args
        for row in connection.execute("SELECT message_json FROM worker_messages WHERE run_id=? AND role='assistant'", (run["id"],))
        for call in json.loads(row[0]).get("tool_calls", [])
    )
    if not matched or not payload.get("budget_call_id"):
        raise DomainError("Expert expansion lacks its original model transcript")
    if unresolved_calls(connection, run["id"]) or connection.execute("SELECT 1 FROM model_budget_attempts WHERE worker_run_id=? AND state IN ('reserved','unknown')", (run["id"],)).fetchone() or connection.execute("SELECT 1 FROM worker_model_reservations WHERE run_id=? AND state='reserved'", (run["id"],)).fetchone():
        raise DomainError("Unknown effects block expert expansion")
    if run["state"] not in {"blocked", "failed", "cancelled"}:
        raise DomainError("Expert expansion requires a stopped Worker")
    parent = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM quest_plans WHERE id=? AND quest_id=?", (run["plan_id"], quest_id)).fetchone()
    if not parent or parent["revision"] != run["plan_revision"] or parent["digest"] != run["plan_digest"]:
        raise DomainError("Expert expansion parent assignment changed")
    return run, parent, payload, policy, mandate["id"]


def _expansion_graph(connection, quest_id, event_id):
    """Derive a fixed fan-in from model-selected specialist responsibilities."""
    from .graph_domain import GraphProposal, graph_contract_dump
    from .superagent_delegation import _split_budget

    run, parent, payload, policy, mandate_id = _expansion_source(connection, quest_id, event_id)
    original = json.loads(parent["graph_json"])
    old = next(item for item in original["nodes"] if item["key"] == run["node_key"])
    used = connection.execute("SELECT COUNT(*),COALESCE(SUM(token_limit),0),COALESCE(SUM(tool_limit),0) FROM worker_runs WHERE quest_id=?", (quest_id,)).fetchone()
    # A stopped initial Worker plus two specialists and one integrator is four.
    if used[0] + 3 > policy["max_workers"] or used[2] + 3 > policy["max_tools"]:
        raise DomainError("Dynamic expert expansion exceeds remaining Worker/tool slots")
    parent_allocated = connection.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(token_limit),0) FROM worker_runs WHERE quest_id=? AND node_key=?", (quest_id, run["node_key"])).fetchone()[0]
    residual = old["budget_tokens"] - parent_allocated
    if residual < 3:
        raise DomainError("No original parent allocation remains for expert expansion")
    budgets = _split_budget(residual, 3)
    keys = [run["node_key"] + "_expert_1", run["node_key"] + "_expert_2", run["node_key"] + "_integrator"]
    child_roles = [item["role"] for item in payload["experts"]]
    children = []
    for index, key in enumerate(keys):
        child = deepcopy(old)
        child.update(key=key, budget_tokens=budgets[index])
        child["capacity_bounds"] = child.get("capacity_bounds") or {"max_source_receipt_bytes": 32768, "max_artifact_bytes": 16384, "max_delivery_bytes": 16384}
        if index < 2:
            child.update(objective=payload["experts"][index]["objective"], success_criteria=["delivery_review"], expected_artifact=None)
            if child_roles[index] not in {"coding", "experiment"}:
                child["allowed_tools"] = [tool for tool in child["allowed_tools"] if tool != "python_unittest"]
        else:
            child["objective"] = "Integrate the two specialist deliveries and complete the original objective: " + old["objective"]
            child["required_predecessor_deliveries"] = keys[:2]
            if "worker_read_completed_delivery" not in child["allowed_tools"]:
                raise DomainError("Parent mandate does not allow verified expert handoffs")
        children.append(child)
    raw = deepcopy(original)
    raw.pop("revision_lineage", None)
    raw["nodes"] = [item for item in raw["nodes"] if item["key"] != run["node_key"]] + children
    new_edges = []
    for edge in raw["edges"]:
        if edge["target"] == run["node_key"]:
            new_edges.extend({**edge, "target": key} for key in keys[:2])
        elif edge["source"] == run["node_key"]:
            new_edges.append({**edge, "source": keys[2]})
        else:
            new_edges.append(edge)
    new_edges.extend({"source": key, "target": keys[2], "condition": "success"} for key in keys[:2])
    raw["edges"] = new_edges
    return graph_contract_dump(GraphProposal.model_validate(raw)), child_roles, run, parent, policy, mandate_id


def validate_expansion_plan(connection, quest_id, revision, digest, body):
    from .hierarchical_plans import expansion_contract
    from .plan_lineage import validate_pending_lineage

    proposed = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM quest_plans WHERE quest_id=? AND revision=? AND digest=?", (quest_id, revision, digest)).fetchone()
    source = connection.execute("SELECT payload FROM events WHERE quest_id=? AND event_type='quest.plan_proposed' AND json_extract(payload,'$.plan_id')=? ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1", (quest_id, proposed["id"] if proposed else None)).fetchone()
    source_id = json.loads(source[0]).get("expert_source_event_id") if source else None
    if not source_id:
        raise DomainError("Expansion plan lacks its original model decision")
    raw, _, run, parent, _policy, _mandate_id = _expansion_graph(connection, quest_id, source_id)
    actual = deepcopy(body)
    actual.pop("revision_lineage", None)
    actual.pop("hierarchical_expansions", None)
    expected = deepcopy(raw)
    expected.pop("hierarchical_expansions", None)
    if actual != expected:
        raise DomainError("Expansion plan changed the model-selected expert contracts")
    quest = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM quests WHERE id=?", (quest_id,)).fetchone()
    lineage = validate_pending_lineage(connection, quest, proposed)
    derived = expansion_contract(json.loads(parent["graph_json"]), body, parent, run["node_key"], {item["node_key"] for item in lineage["completed_nodes"]})
    if derived != body.get("hierarchical_expansions"):
        raise DomainError("Expansion history differs from the original parent")


def expand_experts(service, event_id):
    """Resume bounded expansion at persisted plan/team transaction boundaries."""
    from .domain import ForgeEvent
    from .hierarchical_plans import node_depth
    from .superagent_delegation import DelegationAuthority
    from .team_composition import PRESET_ROLES, CompositionLimits, RoleSpec
    from .worker_schema import STRICT_DELIVERY_OUTPUT_SCHEMA

    store = service.store
    with store.connection() as c:
        event = c.execute("SELECT quest_id FROM events WHERE id=?", (event_id,)).fetchone()
        if not event:
            raise DomainError("Expert event is unavailable")
        quest_id = event["quest_id"]
        if c.execute("SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE quest_id=? AND event_type='superagent.experts_expanded' AND json_extract(payload,'$.source_event_id')=?", (quest_id, event_id)).fetchone():
            return False
        raw, child_roles, old_run, parent, policy, mandate_id = _expansion_graph(c, quest_id, event_id)
        staged = c.execute("SELECT p.* FROM quest_plans p JOIN events e ON json_extract(e.payload,'$.plan_id')=p.id WHERE p.quest_id=? AND e.event_type='quest.plan_proposed' AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.expert_source_event_id')=? ORDER BY p.revision DESC LIMIT 1", (quest_id, event_id)).fetchone()
        version = c.execute("SELECT version FROM quests WHERE id=?", (quest_id,)).fetchone()[0]
    authority = DelegationAuthority(mandate_id)
    if staged is None:
        staged = service.graph.propose_remaining(quest_id, raw, expected_version=version, expansion_parent=old_run["node_key"], _planner_provenance={"expert_source_event_id": event_id})
    else:
        staged = {**dict(staged), "plan_revision": staged["revision"]}
    if staged["status"] == "proposed":
        staged = service.graph.approve(quest_id, staged["digest"], staged["plan_revision"], expected_version=store.get_quest(quest_id)["version"], actor=authority.actor, _delegation=authority)
    with store.connection() as c:
        current = service.graph.get(quest_id)
        if current["id"] != staged["id"] or current["status"] != "approved":
            raise DomainError("Expanded current plan changed")
        team = c.execute("SELECT * FROM team_proposals WHERE quest_id=? AND plan_revision=? AND status IN ('proposed','approved') ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (quest_id, current["plan_revision"])).fetchone()
        used = c.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tool_limit),0) FROM worker_runs WHERE quest_id=?", (quest_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        profiles = store.list_models()
    if team is None:
        known = [profile for profile in profiles if profile.enabled and not profile.quarantine_reason and profile.context_window and profile.max_output_tokens and profile.tool_calling_support and profile.tool_calling_support.supported]
        if not known:
            raise DomainError("No available expert model")
        window = min(profile.context_window for profile in known)
        output = min(8192, min(profile.max_output_tokens for profile in known), window // 4)
        remaining_seconds = int(datetime.fromisoformat(parent["approved_at"]).timestamp() + policy["max_seconds"] - time.time())
        if remaining_seconds < 1:
            raise DomainError("Original expert task deadline expired")
        members = []
        for index, node in enumerate(current["nodes"]):
            role = child_roles[index] if index < 2 else "architect"
            members.append(RoleSpec(
                id=f"{role}_expanded_{index+1}", dynamic=True, depth=node_depth(current, node["key"]), task_node_key=node["key"],
                required_capabilities={name: 0.0 for name in PRESET_ROLES[role] if any(name in profile.capability_measurements for profile in known)},
                tools=node["allowed_tools"], input_tokens=min(window, 65536, node["budget_tokens"]-output), output_tokens=output,
                max_steps=policy["max_steps"], max_tool_calls=(policy["max_tools"]-used)//len(current["nodes"]),
                max_duration_seconds=min(remaining_seconds, policy["max_seconds"]//len(current["nodes"])),
                responsibility=node["objective"], input_contract=["Preserve the complete original request. Read every declared predecessor delivery before integration."],
                REDACTED, acceptance_criteria=node["success_criteria"],
            ))
        proposal = service.teams.propose(quest_id, members, CompositionLimits(
            max_members=len(members), max_depth=1, max_concurrency=min(service.max_concurrency, len(members)), max_total_tokens=policy["max_tokens"], max_total_tool_calls=policy["max_tools"], allowed_tools=sorted({tool for member in members for tool in member.tools}),
        ), strategy="complementarity", expected_version=store.get_quest(quest_id)["version"])
        team_digest = proposal["proposal_digest"]
    else:
        team_digest = team["proposal_digest"]
    if team is None or team["status"] == "proposed":
        service.teams.approve(quest_id, current["plan_revision"], team_digest, expected_version=store.get_quest(quest_id)["version"], actor=authority.actor, _delegation=authority)
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        work.append_event(ForgeEvent(event_type="superagent.experts_expanded", quest_id=quest_id, payload={"source_event_id": event_id, "source_run_id": old_run["id"], "plan_id": current["id"], "proposal_digest": team_digest}))
    return True

    c.execute(

def _expansion_graph(connection, quest_id, event_id):
    """Derive a fixed fan-in from model-selected specialist responsibilities."""
    from .graph_domain import GraphProposal, graph_contract_dump
    from .superagent_delegation import _split_budget

    run, parent, payload, policy, mandate_id = _expansion_source(connection, quest_id, event_id)
    original = json.loads(parent["graph_json"])
    old = next(item for item in original["nodes"] if item["key"] == run["node_key"])
    used = connection.execute("SELECT COUNT(*),COALESCE(SUM(token_limit),0),COALESCE(SUM(tool_limit),0) FROM worker_runs WHERE quest_id=?", (quest_id,)).fetchone()
    # A stopped initial Worker plus two specialists and one integrator is four.
    if used[0] + 3 > policy["max_workers"] or used[2] + 3 > policy["max_tools"]:
        raise DomainError("Dynamic expert expansion exceeds remaining Worker/tool slots")
    parent_allocated = connection.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(token_limit),0) FROM worker_runs WHERE quest_id=? AND node_key=?", (quest_id, run["node_key"])).fetchone()[0]
    residual = old["budget_tokens"] - parent_allocated
    if residual < 3:
        raise DomainError("No original parent allocation remains for expert expansion")
    budgets = _split_budget(residual, 3)
    keys = [run["node_key"] + "_expert_1", run["node_key"] + "_expert_2", run["node_key"] + "_integrator"]
    child_roles = [item["role"] for item in payload["experts"]]
    children = []
    for index, key in enumerate(keys):
        child = deepcopy(old)
        child.update(key=key, budget_tokens=budgets[index])
        child["capacity_bounds"] = child.get("capacity_bounds") or {"max_source_receipt_bytes": 32768, "max_artifact_bytes": 16384, "max_delivery_bytes": 16384}
        if index < 2:
            child.update(objective=payload["experts"][index]["objective"], success_criteria=["delivery_review"], expected_artifact=None)
            if child_roles[index] not in {"coding", "experiment"}:
                child["allowed_tools"] = [tool for tool in child["allowed_tools"] if tool != "python_unittest"]
        else:
            child["objective"] = "Integrate the two specialist deliveries and complete the original objective: " + old["objective"]
            child["required_predecessor_deliveries"] = keys[:2]
            if "worker_read_completed_delivery" not in child["allowed_tools"]:
                raise DomainError("Parent mandate does not allow verified expert handoffs")
        children.append(child)
    raw = deepcopy(original)
    raw.pop("revision_lineage", None)
    raw["nodes"] = [item for item in raw["nodes"] if item["key"] != run["node_key"]] + children
    new_edges = []
    for edge in raw["edges"]:
        if edge["target"] == run["node_key"]:
            new_edges.extend({**edge, "target": key} for key in keys[:2])
        elif edge["source"] == run["node_key"]:
            new_edges.append({**edge, "source": keys[2]})
        else:
            new_edges.append(edge)
    new_edges.extend({"source": key, "target": keys[2], "condition": "success"} for key in keys[:2])
    raw["edges"] = new_edges
    return graph_contract_dump(GraphProposal.model_validate(raw)), child_roles, run, parent, policy, mandate_id

    def graph_valid(self):
        if (self.max_cost_microunits is None) != (self.cost_currency is None):
            raise ValueError("A cost limit requires an explicit currency")
        keys = [node.key for node in self.nodes]
        if len(keys) != len(set(keys)) or (
            token_budgets_enforced()
            and sum(node.budget_tokens for node in self.nodes) > self.max_total_tokens
        ):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate node or total budget exceeded")
        incoming = dict.fromkeys(keys, 0)
        outgoing = {key: [] for key in keys}
        edges = set()
        for edge in self.edges:
            pair = (edge.source, edge.target)
            if edge.source not in incoming or edge.target not in incoming or pair in edges:
                raise ValueError("Invalid graph edge")
            edges.add(pair)
            incoming[edge.target] += 1
            outgoing[edge.source].append(edge.target)
        ready = [key for key, count in incoming.items() if count == 0]
        count = 0
        while ready:
            node = ready.pop()
            count += 1
            for child in outgoing[node]:
                incoming[child] -= 1
                if incoming[child] == 0:
                    ready.append(child)
        if count != len(keys):
            raise ValueError("Graph contains a cycle")
        for node in self.nodes:
            parents = success_ancestors([edge.model_dump() for edge in self.edges], node.key)
            if set(node.required_predecessor_deliveries or []) - parents:
                raise ValueError("Completed delivery must be an approved success ancestor")
        if self.serial_capacity_policy is not None:

            validate_serial_policy(self.model_dump())
        return self

application: one persistent Router conversation coordinates hidden, isolated
Workers and continuously receives events.

## Engineering status — 2026-11-16

The backend architecture now follows DeepSeek Super-agent's
persistent Router and independent Workers. The default Core delegates ordinary
conversational tasks automatically, filters environmental events, sends Thread
continuations directly to subscribed Workers, follows typed Chain of Recall
references, and supervises durable execution. Plans, Quests and approval records
are internal infrastructure. The frontend is unchanged in this correction.

def test_initial_native_measurement_includes_both_core_tools_and_escaped_source(tmp_path, kind):
    store, manager, _model, worker = prepared(tmp_path, [])
    source = '必须保留中文、路径 C:\\work\\"quoted" 和换行\n不要删除原始证据'
    original = ConversationMessage(role="user", content=source)
    store.add_message(original)
    ConstraintService(store).record_extraction(
        source,
        source_message_id=original.id,
        quest_id=worker["quest_id"],
        origin="explicit_user",
    )
    posts = []
    gateway = ObservedGateway(
        transport=httpx.MockTransport(lambda request: posts.append(request)), kind=kind
    )
    graph = QuestGraphService(store).get(worker["quest_id"])
    extra = {"role": "user", "content": "Verified source slice (untrusted): " + source}
    with store.connection() as connection:
        connection.execute("BEGIN")
        team = manager.team_authority.get_approved(
            worker["quest_id"],
            worker["plan_revision"],
            worker["team_digest"],
            connection=connection,
        )
        before = connection.total_changes
        measured = measure_initial_worker_request(
            store,
            connection,
            store.get_quest(worker["quest_id"]),
            graph,
            graph["nodes"][0],
            team["members"][0],
            extra_messages=[extra],
            provider=gateway,
        )
        assert connection.total_changes == before
    request, payload = gateway.serialized[-1]
    assert request.messages[-1] == extra
    assert any("Sourced constraint records" in item["content"] for item in request.messages)
    assert [item["name"] for item in request.tools] == [
        "file_read",
        "worker_read_context_source",
        "worker_request_help",
    ]
    wire = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")

    assert "中文".encode() in wire and b"\\n" in wire and b"\\\\" in wire and b'\\"' in wire
    assert measured["native_input_reservation"] == len(wire) + 64
    stripped_request = replace(request, tools=request.tools[:1])
    stripped = json.dumps(gateway._payload(stripped_request, False), ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    core_framing_bytes = len(wire) - len(stripped)

    assert measured["input_reservation"] >= len(stripped) + core_framing_bytes + 64
    assert (
        measured["total_reservation"] == measured["input_reservation"] + request.max_output_tokens
    )
    assert not posts and gateway.execution_mode == "mock"

from .domain import DomainError, now_iso


def _json(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def _hash(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(_json(value).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _router_handoff_input(snapshot, selected, previous):
    """Bind a model handoff to its exact complete inputs and archive frontier."""
    return {
        "version": "router-model-handoff-input-v1",
        "archive_head": snapshot["archive_head"],
        "router_state_hash": _hash(snapshot["state"]),
        "previous_context": previous.get("model_handoff", {}).get("text", previous),
        "messages": [
            {"id": row["id"], "role": row["role"], "content": row["content"]} for row in selected
        ],
        "source_hashes": [{"id": row["id"], "hash": _hash(row)} for row in selected],
    }


def _worker_handoff_input(prepared, selected):
    return {
        "version": "worker-model-handoff-input-v1",
        "frontier_digest": _hash(prepared["snapshot"]),
        "task": prepared["task"],
        "previous_context": prepared["previous"]
        .get("model_handoff", {})
        .get("text", prepared["previous"]),
        "messages": [
            {"ordinal": row["ordinal"], "message": json.loads(row["message_json"])}
            for row in selected
        ],
        "source_hashes": [{"id": row["ordinal"], "hash": _hash(row)} for row in selected],
    }


def _worker_batch_boundaries(rows):
    """Prefixes end only after every assistant tool call has all its results."""
    pending, boundaries = set(), []
    for index, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
        message = json.loads(row["message_json"])
        if row["role"] == "assistant":
            ids = [call.get("id") for call in message.get("tool_calls", [])]
            if None in ids or len(set(ids)) != len(ids) or pending.intersection(ids):
                raise DomainError("Invalid Worker tool call pairing")
            pending.update(ids)
        elif row["role"] == "tool":
            identity = message.get("tool_call_id")
            if identity not in pending:
                raise DomainError("Invalid Worker tool result pairing")
            pending.remove(identity)
        if not pending:
            boundaries.append(index)
    return boundaries


def _excerpt(value, max_bytes=1024):
    return value.encode("utf-8")[:max_bytes].decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")


def _bounded_items(items, *, limit, max_bytes, anchors=4):
    """Keep initial anchors and recent items; omitted sources remain archived."""
    selected, used = [], 2
    candidates = list(enumerate(items[:anchors])) + list(
        reversed(list(enumerate(items[anchors:], start=anchors)))
    )
    for index, item in candidates:
        size = len(_json(item).encode("utf-8")) + bool(selected)
        if len(selected) < limit and used + size <= max_bytes:
            selected.append((index, item))
            used += size
    selected.sort(key=lambda entry: entry[0])
    return [item for _, item in selected], len(items) - len(selected)

        if not isinstance(provider, ProviderGateway) or provider.config is None:
            raise DomainError("Worker compaction requires its original configured Gateway")
        self.manager, self.provider = manager, provider
        self.run_id, self.token = REDACTED, token
        self.service = ContextService(manager.store)
        with manager.store.unit_of_work() as work:
            c = work.connection
            row = manager._fenced(c, run_id, token)
            if (
                provider.config.id != row["provider_id"]
                or provider.execution_mode != row["execution_mode"]
            ):
                raise DomainError("Worker compaction Provider binding changed")
            self.context_limit = min(context_limit, row["model_context_window"])
            self.output_limit = min(
                output_limit, row["model_max_output_tokens"], max(1, self.context_limit // 8)
            )
            self.model_id, self.provider_id = row["model_id"], row["provider_id"]

    def _fence(self, connection):
        return self.manager._fenced(connection, self.run_id, self.token)

    def _checkpoint_fence(self, connection, request, usage):
        row = self._fence(connection)
        local = connection.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM worker_model_reservations WHERE call_id=?",
            (request.budget_context.call_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if (
            not verified_compaction_usage(connection, self.provider, request, usage)
            or local is None
            or local["state"] != "settled"
            or local["run_id"] != self.run_id
            or local["generation"] != row["generation"]
            or local["lease_token"] != self.token
            or json.loads(local["context_json"]).get("purpose") != "context_compaction"
            or local["input_tokens"] != usage["input_tokens"]
            or local["output_tokens"] != usage["output_tokens"]
        ):
            raise DomainError("Worker compaction settlement changed before checkpoint")
        return row

    def _request(self, prepared, selected, call_id, input_budget):
        packet = _worker_handoff_input(prepared, selected)
        summary_bytes = min(
            self.output_limit * 8, self.context_limit // 4, input_budget // 4, 65536
        )
        row = prepared["snapshot"]["run"]
        request = ModelRequest(
            provider_id=self.provider_id,
            model_id=self.model_id,
            messages=[
                {
                    "role": "system",
                    "content": HANDOFF_PROMPT.replace("Router", "Worker")
                    + f"The complete summary must fit in {summary_bytes} UTF-8 bytes.",
                },
                {"role": "user", "content": _json(packet)},
            ],
            max_output_tokens=self.output_limit,
            context_limit=self.context_limit,
            max_retries=0,
            timeout_seconds=max(
                0.001,
                min(
                    self.provider.config.timeout_seconds,
                    row["deadline"] - self.manager._now(),
                    row["lease_until"] - self.manager._now(),
                ),
            ),
            budget_context=ModelCallContext(
                call_id=call_id,
                purpose="context_compaction",
                workspace_id=self.manager.store.workspace.id,
                quest_id=row["quest_id"],
                worker_run_id=self.run_id,
            ),
        )
        return request, _hash(packet), summary_bytes

    def _reserve(self, prepared, request):
        native_input = (
            len(json.dumps(self.provider._payload(request, False), ensure_ascii=False).encode())
            + 64
        )
        reserve = native_input + request.max_output_tokens
        with self.manager.store.unit_of_work() as work:
            c = work.connection
            row = self._fence(c)
            if row["steps"] + 1 >= row["step_limit"]:
                raise DomainError("Worker compaction must retain an execution step")
            if c.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM worker_model_reservations WHERE run_id=? AND state='reserved'",
                (self.run_id,),
            ).fetchone():
                raise DomainError("Worker has an unresolved model call")
            if c.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM model_budget_attempts WHERE worker_run_id=? "
                "AND purpose='context_compaction' AND state!='settled'",
                (self.run_id,),
            ).fetchone():
                raise DomainError("Worker has an unresolved compaction Gateway attempt")
            policy = capacity_policy(prepared["task"])
            cycle = cycle_allowance(c, row, policy) if policy else None
            held = cycle["held_after_current_request"] if cycle else 0
            if (
                token_budgets_enforced()
                and row["token_spent"] + reserve + held > row["token_limit"]
            ):
                raise DomainError("Worker compaction token allocation exhausted")
            if (
                cycle
                and cycle["correction_started"]
                and (
                    native_input > policy["correction_input_tokens"]
                    or request.max_output_tokens > policy["correction_output_tokens"]
                )
            ):
                raise DomainError("Worker compaction exceeds approved correction request")
            cost, ledgers = None, []
            if row["cost_limit_microunits"] is not None:
                price = json.loads(row["price_bounds_json"])
                cost = (
                    native_input * price["input_microunits_per_million"]
                    + request.max_output_tokens * price["output_microunits_per_million"]
                    + 999999
                ) // 1000000
                ledgers = c.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM worker_cost_ledger WHERE currency=? AND "
                    "((scope='quest' AND scope_id=?) OR (scope='global' AND scope_id='global'))",
                    (row["currency"], row["quest_id"]),
                ).fetchall()
                if (
                    row["cost_spent_microunits"] + cost > row["cost_limit_microunits"]
                    or not ledgers
                    or any(
                        ledger["reserved_microunits"] + cost > ledger["limit_microunits"]
                        for ledger in ledgers
                    )
                ):
                    raise DomainError("Worker compaction cost allocation exhausted")
                c.execute(
                    "UPDATE worker_runs SET cost_spent_microunits=cost_spent_microunits+? WHERE id=?",
                    (cost, self.run_id),
                )
                for ledger in ledgers:
                    c.execute(
                        "UPDATE worker_cost_ledger SET reserved_microunits=reserved_microunits+? "
                        "WHERE scope=? AND scope_id=? AND currency=?",
                        (cost, ledger["scope"], ledger["scope_id"], ledger["currency"]),
                    )
            c.execute(
                "UPDATE worker_runs SET token_spent=token_spent+?,steps=steps+1 WHERE id=?",
                (reserve, self.run_id),
            )
            reserve_worker_model_call(
                c,
                row,
                request.budget_context.call_id,
                reserve,
                request.max_output_tokens,
                cost,
                ledgers,
                purpose="context_compaction",
            )

    async def compact(self, *, input_budget, source_readback_available):
        prepared = self.service._worker_context(
            self.run_id,
            input_budget=input_budget,
            source_readback_available=source_readback_available,
            _prepare=True,
            _fence=self._fence,
        )
        if not prepared["selected"]:
            return {"messages": prepared["messages"], "source_count": 0}
        boundaries = _worker_batch_boundaries(prepared["selected"])
        call_id = new_id("model_call")
        low, high = 0, len(boundaries)
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high + 1) // 2
            request, _digest, _summary_bytes = self._request(
                prepared, prepared["selected"][: boundaries[middle - 1]], call_id, input_budget
            )
            try:
                self.provider._payload(request, False)
            except ProviderError as exc:
                if exc.code != "context_exceeded":
                    raise DomainError("Invalid Worker compaction request") from None
                high = middle - 1
            else:
                low = middle
        if not low:
            raise DomainError("Complete earliest Worker exchange does not fit model context")
        selected = prepared["selected"][: boundaries[low - 1]]
        request, digest, summary_bytes = self._request(prepared, selected, call_id, input_budget)
        self._reserve(prepared, request)
        try:
            response = await asyncio.wait_for(
                self.provider.generate(request), timeout=request.timeout_seconds
            )
        except (ProviderError, TimeoutError) as exc:
            if getattr(exc, "usage", None) is not None:
                self.manager._settle_model_usage(
                    self.run_id, self.token, exc.usage, call_id=call_id
                )
            elif getattr(request, "_budget_post_started", None) is False:
                with self.manager.store.unit_of_work() as work:
                    refund_unsent_worker_model_call(work.connection, call_id, self.token)
            raise DomainError(
                "Worker compaction Provider failed; original context retained"
            ) from None
        with self.manager.store.connection() as connection:
            exact_gateway_usage = verified_compaction_usage(
                connection, self.provider, request, response.usage
            )
        # Settle only from the immutable Gateway proof. Unlike generic mock
        # Worker adapters, a Gateway summary never accepts response-only usage.
        if not exact_gateway_usage:
            raise DomainError("Worker compaction requires exact settled Gateway usage")
        settled = self.manager._settle_model_usage(
            self.run_id, self.token, response.usage, call_id=call_id
        )
        if not settled:
            raise DomainError("Worker compaction has no settled current-owner response")
        if (
            response.tool_calls
            or response.finish_reason not in {"stop", "end_turn", "stop_sequence"}
            or not isinstance(response.text, str)
            or not response.text.strip()
            or len(response.text.encode("utf-8")) > summary_bytes
            or response.provider_id != self.provider_id
            or response.model_id != self.model_id
        ):
            raise DomainError("Invalid Worker compaction handoff")
        self.service._worker_context(
            self.run_id,
            input_budget=input_budget,
            source_readback_available=source_readback_available,
            _fence=lambda connection: self._checkpoint_fence(connection, request, response.usage),
            _expected=prepared["snapshot"],
            _handoff={"text": response.text, "input_digest": digest},
            _max_sources=len(selected),
        )
        return {"source_count": len(selected), "source_ids": [row["ordinal"] for row in selected]}
"""Task-centric, integrity-checked context archives backed by SQLite."""

import hashlib
import json

from .domain import DomainError, now_iso


def _json(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def _hash(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(_json(value).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _router_handoff_input(snapshot, selected, previous):
    """Bind a model handoff to its exact complete inputs and archive frontier."""
    return {
        "version": "router-model-handoff-input-v1",
        "archive_head": snapshot["archive_head"],
        "router_state_hash": _hash(snapshot["state"]),
        "previous_context": previous.get("model_handoff", {}).get("text", previous),
        "messages": [
            {"id": row["id"], "role": row["role"], "content": row["content"]} for row in selected
        ],
        "source_hashes": [{"id": row["id"], "hash": _hash(row)} for row in selected],
    }


def _worker_handoff_input(prepared, selected):
    return {
        "version": "worker-model-handoff-input-v1",
        "frontier_digest": _hash(prepared["snapshot"]),
        "task": prepared["task"],
        "previous_context": prepared["previous"]
        .get("model_handoff", {})
        .get("text", prepared["previous"]),
        "messages": [
            {"ordinal": row["ordinal"], "message": json.loads(row["message_json"])}
            for row in selected
        ],
        "source_hashes": [{"id": row["ordinal"], "hash": _hash(row)} for row in selected],
    }


def _worker_batch_boundaries(rows):
    """Prefixes end only after every assistant tool call has all its results."""
    pending, boundaries = set(), []
    for index, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
        message = json.loads(row["message_json"])
        if row["role"] == "assistant":
            ids = [call.get("id") for call in message.get("tool_calls", [])]
            if None in ids or len(set(ids)) != len(ids) or pending.intersection(ids):
                raise DomainError("Invalid Worker tool call pairing")
            pending.update(ids)
        elif row["role"] == "tool":
            identity = message.get("tool_call_id")
            if identity not in pending:
                raise DomainError("Invalid Worker tool result pairing")
            pending.remove(identity)
        if not pending:
            boundaries.append(index)
    return boundaries


def _excerpt(value, max_bytes=1024):
    return value.encode("utf-8")[:max_bytes].decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")


def _bounded_items(items, *, limit, max_bytes, anchors=4):
    """Keep initial anchors and recent items; omitted sources remain archived."""
    selected, used = [], 2
    candidates = list(enumerate(items[:anchors])) + list(
        reversed(list(enumerate(items[anchors:], start=anchors)))
    )
    for index, item in candidates:
        size = len(_json(item).encode("utf-8")) + bool(selected)
        if len(selected) < limit and used + size <= max_bytes:
            selected.append((index, item))
            used += size
    selected.sort(key=lambda entry: entry[0])
    return [item for _, item in selected], len(items) - len(selected)


def _settled_receipted_exchange(store, connection, run_id, rows):
    """Only a whole successful, receipted tail may leave the live protocol."""
    if not rows or rows[0]["role"] != "assistant":
        return False
    request = json.loads(rows[0]["message_json"])
    calls = request.get("tool_calls", [])
    identities = [call.get("id") for call in calls]
    if not identities or None in identities or len(set(identities)) != len(identities):
        return False
    replies = [json.loads(row["message_json"]) for row in rows[1:]]
    if (
        len(replies) != len(calls)
        or any(row["role"] != "tool" for row in rows[1:])
        or {reply.get("tool_call_id") for reply in replies} != set(identities)
    ):
        return False
    for call in calls:
        name = call.get("function", {}).get("name")
        if name == "worker_read_completed_delivery":
            from .evidence import _verify_worker_context_call

            stored = connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM worker_tool_calls WHERE run_id=? AND model_call_id=? AND tool_name=?",
                (run_id, call["id"], name),
            ).fetchone()
            if stored is None or not _verify_worker_context_call(store, connection, run_id, stored):
                return False
            continue
        verified = connection.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM worker_tool_calls c "
            "JOIN action_receipts r ON r.id=c.receipt_id "
            "JOIN action_intents i ON i.id=r.intent_id "
            "JOIN worker_runs w ON w.id=c.run_id "
            "WHERE c.run_id=? AND c.model_call_id=? AND c.tool_name=? "
            "AND c.state='succeeded' AND i.state='succeeded' "
            "AND i.run_id=c.run_id AND i.call_id=c.call_id AND i.tool_name=c.tool_name "
            "AND i.worker_id=w.worker_id AND i.plan_id=w.plan_id "
            "AND i.plan_revision=w.plan_revision "
            "AND r.execution_mode=i.execution_mode AND i.execution_mode=w.execution_mode",
            (run_id, call["id"], name),
        ).fetchone()
        if verified is None:
            return False
    return True


def _merge_messages(previous, rows):
    merged = [item for item in previous if item.get("role") == "user"]
    highlights = [item for item in previous if item.get("role") != "user"]
    positions = {(item["text"], item["status"]): item for item in merged}
    for row in rows:
        if row["role"] != "user":
            highlights.append(
                {
                    "text": _excerpt(row["content"], 256),
                    "source_refs": [row["id"]],
                    "status": "unverified",
                    "role": row["role"],
                    "omitted": len(row["content"].encode("utf-8")) > 256,
                }
            )
            continue
        text = _excerpt(row["content"])
        key = (text, "unverified")
        if key not in positions:
            item = {
                "text": text,
                "source_refs": [],
                "status": "unverified",
                "role": "user",
                "omitted": text != row["content"],
            }
            positions[key] = item
            merged.append(item)
        positions[key]["source_refs"].append(row["id"])
        if len(positions[key]["source_refs"]) > 4:
            positions[key]["source_refs"] = (
                positions[key]["source_refs"][:1] + positions[key]["source_refs"][-3:]
            )
            positions[key]["omitted"] = True
    merged, omitted_users = _bounded_items(merged, limit=64, max_bytes=12288, anchors=8)
    highlights, omitted_highlights = _bounded_items(highlights, limit=16, max_bytes=4096, anchors=0)
    return merged + highlights, omitted_users + omitted_highlights


def _task_context(connection):
    quests = connection.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM quests WHERE conversation_id='main' AND status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled','failed') ORDER BY id LIMIT 101"
    ).fetchall()
    if len(quests) > 100:
        raise DomainError("Too many active Quests for safe compaction")
    result = []
    for quest in quests:
        qid = quest["id"]
        requirement = connection.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM quest_requirements WHERE quest_id=?", (qid,)
        ).fetchone()

            (qid, quest["plan_revision"]),
        ).fetchone()
        plan = (

            if current_plan
            and current_plan["approved_at"] is not None

        )
        plan_state = "approved" if plan else "pending" if quest["plan_revision"] else "none"
        nodes = (
            connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM task_nodes WHERE plan_id=? ORDER BY node_key", (plan["id"],)
            ).fetchall()

    def _worker_context(
        self,
        run_id,
        *,
        input_budget,
        source_readback_available=False,
        _prepare=False,
        _fence=None,
        _expected=None,
        _handoff=None,
        _max_sources=None,
    ):
        if type(input_budget) is not int or input_budget <= 0:
            raise DomainError("Invalid Worker context budget")
        if type(source_readback_available) is not bool:
            raise DomainError("Invalid Worker source readback availability")
        with self.store.unit_of_work() as work:
            c = work.connection
            if _fence is not None:
                _fence(c)
            archives = self._archives(c, "worker", run_id)
            through = self._through(c, "worker", run_id)
            rows = [
                dict(row)
                for row in c.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM worker_messages WHERE run_id=? AND ordinal>? ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 5001",
                    (run_id, through),
                )
            ]
            capsule_row = c.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM worker_capsules WHERE run_id=?", (run_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if capsule_row is None:
                raise DomainError("Unknown Worker context")
            # Initial system and task messages remain live across every archive.
            initial = (
                [
                    dict(row)
                    for row in c.execute(
                        "SELECT * FROM worker_messages WHERE run_id=? AND ordinal IN (0,1) ORDER BY ordinal",
                        (run_id,),
                    )
                ]
                if through >= 0
                else []
            )
            remaining = initial + rows
            protected_count = 2
            from .worker_prefetch import POLICY, verified_sources

            if json.loads(capsule_row["capsule_json"]).get("input_acquisition_policy") == POLICY:
                run = c.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (run_id,)).fetchone()
                if run is None:
                    raise DomainError("Unknown Worker source context")
                verified_sources(self.store, c, run, historical=False)
                source_ordinals = {
                    item[0]
                    for item in c.execute(
                        "SELECT DISTINCT message_ordinal FROM worker_core_source_reads "
                        "WHERE run_id=? AND state='succeeded'",
                        (run_id,),
                    )
                }
                if any(type(ordinal) is not int or ordinal < 2 for ordinal in source_ordinals):
                    raise DomainError("Invalid Core source message binding")
                pinned_ordinals = {0, 1} | source_ordinals
                placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in pinned_ordinals)
                pinned = [
                    dict(row)
                    for row in c.execute(
                        "SELECT * FROM worker_messages WHERE run_id=? AND ordinal IN ("
                        + placeholders
                        + ") ORDER BY ordinal",
                        (run_id, *sorted(pinned_ordinals)),
                    )
                ]
                if len(pinned) != len(pinned_ordinals):
                    raise DomainError("Core source message unavailable")
                remaining = pinned + [row for row in rows if row["ordinal"] not in pinned_ordinals]
                protected_count = len(pinned)
            run = c.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (run_id,)).fetchone()
            head = c.execute(
                "SELECT h.through,h.archive_id,a.source_hash,a.capsule_hash "
                "FROM context_archive_heads h JOIN context_archives a ON a.id=h.archive_id "
                "WHERE h.scope='worker' AND h.scope_id=?",
                (run_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            snapshot = {
                "run": {
                    key: run[key]
                    for key in (
                        "id",
                        "worker_id",
                        "quest_id",
                        "plan_id",
                        "plan_revision",
                        "plan_digest",
                        "team_digest",
                        "generation",
                        "lease_token",
                        "lease_until",
                        "deadline",
                        "state",
                claims, limit=24, max_bytes=min(8192, input_budget // 4), anchors=2
            )
            completed, omitted_completed = _bounded_items(
                completed, limit=32, max_bytes=min(8192, input_budget // 4), anchors=4
            )
            capsule["hypotheses"] = claims
            capsule["completed_steps"] = completed
            capsule["history_recall"]["omitted_highlights"] += omitted_claims + omitted_completed

            result = compacted_result()
            # Fixed task contracts and live tool pairs take priority over archived
            # highlights. Every removed highlight still has its original source.
            while len(_json(result).encode("utf-8")) > input_budget and (
                capsule["hypotheses"] or capsule["completed_steps"]
            ):
                target = capsule["hypotheses"] or capsule["completed_steps"]
                target.pop()
                capsule["history_recall"]["omitted_highlights"] += 1
                result = compacted_result()
            if len(_json(result).encode("utf-8")) > input_budget and (
                _handoff is None or _max_sources == len(prepared["selected"])
            ):
                raise DomainError("Worker context budget exceeded after compaction")
            if _prepare:
                return prepared
            sources = [{"id": row["ordinal"], "hash": _hash(row)} for row in selected]
            self._record_archive(c, "worker", run_id, sources, capsule, selected[-1]["ordinal"])
            changed = c.execute(
                "UPDATE worker_capsules SET revision=revision+1 WHERE run_id=? AND revision=?",
                (run_id, capsule_row["revision"]),
            )
            if changed.rowcount != 1:
                raise DomainError("Worker context changed concurrently")
            return result

    def read_source(self, scope, scope_id, source_id):
        if scope not in {"router", "worker"}:
            raise ValueError("Invalid context scope")
        with self.store.connection() as c:
            c.execute("BEGIN")
            row = self._verify_source(c, scope, scope_id, source_id)
            c.commit()
            return dict(row)

"""Bounded, explainable team proposals; never starts a Worker or grants a tool."""

import hashlib
import json
import math
import time
from copy import deepcopy
from decimal import ROUND_CEILING, Decimal
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

from .domain import DomainError, ForgeEvent, ModelProfile, new_id, now_iso
from .token_policy import token_budgets_enforced
from .worker_schema import DELIVERY_OUTPUT_SCHEMA, STRICT_DELIVERY_OUTPUT_SCHEMA


class RoleSpec(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False, revalidate_instances="always")
    id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    task_node_key: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=100)
    required_capabilities: dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict, max_length=32)
    tools: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=32)
    input_tokens: int = Field(ge=0, le=1000000)
    output_tokens: int = Field(gt=0, le=1000000)
    max_steps: int = Field(default=8, ge=1, le=32)
    max_tool_calls: int = Field(default=8, ge=0, le=64)
    max_duration_seconds: int = Field(default=60, ge=1, le=3600)
    depth: int = Field(default=0, ge=0, le=8)
    dynamic: bool = False
    responsibility: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    input_contract: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    output_schema: dict | None = None
    acceptance_criteria: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def valid_requirements(self):
        if any(
            not name or not math.isfinite(value) or not 0 <= value <= 100
            for name, value in self.required_capabilities.items()
        ):
            raise ValueError("Invalid capability requirements")
        if any(not tool for tool in self.tools) or len(set(self.tools)) != len(self.tools):
            raise ValueError("Invalid tool scope")
        if self.id not in PRESET_ROLES and not self.dynamic:
            raise ValueError(
                "Unknown role requires a dynamic proposal; preset IDs are "
                + ", ".join(PRESET_ROLES)
            )
        if any(
            not text.strip() or len(text) > 1000
            for text in [*self.input_contract, *self.acceptance_criteria]
        ):
            raise ValueError("Invalid role contract")
        if self.dynamic and (
            not self.responsibility
            or not self.responsibility.strip()
            or not self.input_contract
            or not self.output_schema
            or not self.acceptance_criteria
        ):
            raise ValueError("Dynamic role requires a complete contract")
        if self.output_schema is not None:
            _validate_output_schema(self.output_schema)
        return self


class CompositionLimits(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False, revalidate_instances="always")
    max_members: int = Field(ge=1, le=16)
    max_depth: int = Field(ge=0, le=8)
    max_concurrency: int = Field(ge=1, le=16)
    max_total_tokens: int = Field(gt=0, le=16000000)
    max_total_tool_calls: int = Field(default=64, ge=0, le=1024)
    max_cost_microunits: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    currency: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=3, max_length=3, pattern=r"^[A-Z]{3}$")
    allowed_tools: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=32)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_limits(self):
        if self.max_concurrency > self.max_members:
            raise ValueError("Concurrency exceeds member limit")
        if self.max_cost_microunits is not None and self.currency is None:
            raise ValueError("A monetary cap requires an explicit currency")
        if any(not tool for tool in self.allowed_tools) or len(set(self.allowed_tools)) != len(
            self.allowed_tools
        ):
            raise ValueError("Invalid allowed tools")
        return self


PRESET_ROLES = {
    "research": {"research": 70},
    "math": {"mathematics": 70},
    "planner": {"planning": 70},
    "architect": {"architecture": 70},
    "coding": {"coding": 70},
    "design": {"design": 70},
    "experiment": {"coding": 60, "mathematics": 60},
    "reviewer": {"instruction_following": 70},
}

PRESET_RESPONSIBILITIES = {
    "research": "Gather and synthesize relevant evidence.",
    "math": "Develop and check quantitative reasoning.",
    "planner": "Break down objectives and identify dependencies.",
    "architect": "Design system structure and interfaces.",
    "coding": "Implement and inspect the assigned change.",
    "design": "Develop visual and interaction concepts.",
    "experiment": "Design and evaluate reproducible experiments.",
    "reviewer": "Independently examine results and evidence.",
}
# Phase 2 delivery contract (Summary/Findings/Decisions/Artifacts/Evidence/
# Unresolved/Confidence/Next actions). Kept in one place so the Worker prompt,
# the default role contract and the reviewer all describe the same structure.
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_SCHEMA = DELIVERY_OUTPUT_SCHEMA


def _validate_output_schema(schema):
    if len(json.dumps(schema, allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")) > 8192:
        raise ValueError("Output schema exceeds size limit")

    def visit(node, depth):
        if not isinstance(node, dict) or depth > 8:
            raise ValueError("Invalid output schema")
        kind = node.get("type")
        if kind == "object":
            if set(node) - {"type", "properties", "required", "additionalProperties"}:
                raise ValueError("Unsupported output schema keyword")
            properties = node.get("properties")
            if (
                not isinstance(properties, dict)
                or len(properties) > 32
                or node.get("additionalProperties") is not False
            ):
                raise ValueError("Output object must be bounded and closed")
            required = node.get("required")
            if (
                not isinstance(required, list)
                or len(set(required)) != len(required)
                or not set(required) <= set(properties)
                or not required

import json

from .domain import DomainError

SERIAL_CAPACITY_VERSION = "serial-capacity-v1"


def validate_serial_policy(graph):
    policy = graph.get("serial_capacity_policy")
    if policy is None:
        return None
    if (
        not isinstance(policy, dict)
        or set(policy) != {"version", "shared_reserve_tokens"}
        or policy["version"] != SERIAL_CAPACITY_VERSION
        or type(policy["shared_reserve_tokens"]) is not int
        or not 1 <= policy["shared_reserve_tokens"] <= 1000000
        or graph.get("max_cost_microunits") is not None
        or graph.get("cost_currency") is not None
    ):
        raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires an explicit bounded token-only reserve")
    nodes = graph["nodes"]
    keys = {node["key"] for node in nodes}
    edges = graph["edges"]
    incoming, outgoing = dict.fromkeys(keys, 0), dict.fromkeys(keys, 0)
    for edge in edges:
        if (
            edge["condition"] != "success"
            or edge["source"] not in keys
            or edge["target"] not in keys
        ):
            raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires one strict success chain")
        incoming[edge["target"]] += 1
        outgoing[edge["source"]] += 1
    if (
        len(keys) != len(nodes)
        or len(nodes) < 2
        or len(edges) != len(nodes) - 1
        or max(incoming.values(), default=0) > 1
        or max(outgoing.values(), default=0) > 1
        or sum(value == 0 for value in incoming.values()) != 1
        or sum(value == 0 for value in outgoing.values()) != 1
    ):
        raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires one strict success chain")
    cursor = next(key for key, count in incoming.items() if count == 0)
    seen = set()
    while cursor is not None and cursor not in seen:
        seen.add(cursor)
        cursor = next((edge["target"] for edge in edges if edge["source"] == cursor), None)
    if seen != keys or cursor is not None:
        raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires a connected acyclic success chain")
    reserve = graph.get("coordination_reserve_tokens")
    if type(reserve) is not int or (
        token_budgets_enforced()
        and (
            reserve < (graph["max_total_tokens"] + 9) // 10
            or sum(node["budget_tokens"] for node in nodes)
            + policy["shared_reserve_tokens"]
            + reserve
            > graph["max_total_tokens"]
        )
    ):
        raise DomainError(
            "Serial baselines, one shared reserve and coordination exceed original cap"
        )
    return dict(policy)


def node_execution_limit(graph, node):

    return node["budget_tokens"] + (policy["shared_reserve_tokens"] if policy else 0)

import asyncio

import json
import sqlite3

import pytest

from forge_core.domain import ConversationMessage, DomainError, ForgeEvent, Quest
from forge_core.registry import ModelRegistry, TeamComposer
from forge_core.router import RouterService
from forge_core.store import Store


class MockProvider:
    """Explicit mock; no remote model or worker runs in these tests."""

    execution_mode = "mock"

    def __init__(self, decision):
        self.decision = decision
        self.calls = 0

    async def generate(self, request):
        self.calls += 1
        return type("Response", (), {"text": json.dumps(self.decision), "usage": {}})()


def test_router_informs_tool_limits_and_last_round_requires_final_decision(tmp_path):
    _store, _, router = make_router(tmp_path, {})

    class Provider:
        execution_mode = "mock"

        def __init__(self):
            self.requests = []

        async def generate(self, request):
            self.requests.append(request)
            assert request.context_limit == router.context_limit
            assert "4" in request.messages[0]["content"]
            if len(self.requests) < 4:
                assert request.tools
                return type(
                    "Response",
                    (),
                    {
                        "text": "",
                        "tool_calls": [
                            {"id": f"t{len(self.requests)}", "name": "list_quests", "arguments": {}}
                        ],
                    },
                )()
            assert not request.tools
            assert "final" in request.messages[-1]["content"].lower()
            return type(
                "Response",
                (),
                {
                    "text": json.dumps(
                        {
                            "intent": "chat",
                            "reply": "ok",
                            "title": None,
                            "goal": None,
                            "quest_id": None,
                            "candidates": [],
                        }
                    ),
                    "usage": {},
                },
            )()

    provider = Provider()
    router.provider = provider
    result = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message("hello", request_id="tool-limits"))
    assert result["intent"] == "chat"
    assert len(provider.requests) == 4


def test_router_still_rejects_five_tool_calls(tmp_path):
    store, _, router = make_router(tmp_path, {})

    class Provider:
        execution_mode = "mock"

        async def generate(self, request):
            return type(
                "Response",
                (),
                {
                    "text": "",
                    "tool_calls": [
                        {"id": str(i), "name": "list_quests", "arguments": {}} for i in range(5)
                    ],
                },
            )()

    router.provider = Provider()
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="Too many Router tool calls"):
        asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message("hello", request_id="tool-overflow"))
    assert store.list_messages() == []


def test_router_rejects_tools_returned_on_final_round(tmp_path):
    store, _, router = make_router(tmp_path, {})

    class Provider:
        execution_mode = "mock"

        async def generate(self, request):
            return type(
                "Response",
                (),
                {"text": "", "tool_calls": [{"id": "t", "name": "list_quests", "arguments": {}}]},
            )()

    router.provider = Provider()
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="final round cannot call tools"):
        asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message("hello", request_id="final-tool"))
    assert store.list_messages() == []


def make_router(tmp_path, decision):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "router.sqlite3")
    provider = MockProvider(decision)
    return (
        store,
        provider,
        RouterService(
            store, TeamComposer(ModelRegistry(store)), provider=provider, model_id="mock"
        ),
    )


def test_model_decision_and_request_idempotency(tmp_path):
    decision = {
        "intent": "create_quest",
        "reply": "已登记",
        "title": "研究",
        "goal": "研究",
        "quest_id": None,
        "candidates": [],
    }
    store, provider, router = make_router(tmp_path, decision)
    first = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message("研究", request_id="request-1"))
    second = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message("研究", request_id="request-1"))
    assert first["intent"] == "create_quest"
    assert second["intent"] == "create_quest"
    assert provider.calls == 1
    assert len(store.list_quests()) == 1
